name: @local/dsh-codewiki
description: CodeWiki for DeepSeek Harness: cw CLI + whole-repo wiki compilation pipeline with a sidebar panel. Default channel since 0.16.0 is the native engine (nativeEngine: true) which drives the upstream FSoft-AI4Code/CodeWiki Python engine as a subprocess and requires a local Python 3.10+ venv with closed deps; the in-plugin Node pipeline remains as a minimal compatibility channel (nativeEngine: false, top-level directory grouping + file-level source_files attribution only, no new features). The Node-side reimplementation of FSoft algorithms (symbols/cluster/graph-diff/incremental/update-planner) was retired and deleted in 0.16.0 phase 7. Default model volces-ark/glm-5.3-flash 512k (default tier since 0.16.13; the earlier workbuddy/hy3 192k default was dropped because its window could not hold this repo's module sources), zero subagents, single-project serial.
